records.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:65 — URL conversion incorrectly resolves protocol-relative URLs against the article’s host and leaves document-relative URLs unresolved, breaking imported links and images; resolve references against the article URL using `URI.join`.
records.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in the `absolutize_urls` method at lines 56-72 of topic_embed.rb. The code only handles URLs that `start_with?('/')` (absolute paths), but does not handle protocol-relative URLs (starting with '//') or document-relative URLs (not starting with '/'). For protocol-relative URLs like '//example.com/image.jpg', the code would incorrectly prepend the prefix since '//' starts with '/'.
